title: Lil_trip2much and Joe brrrr serve smooth energy on new single "Double Cup”
htmlContent: Lil_trip2much is back, and this time he's bringing a vibe that you can't ignore at night. Lil_trip2much work with Joe brrrr to make "Double Cup," a melodic rap song that sounds great on dark streets and open roads. The first note of the music creates a calm, atmospheric mood. As the night goes on, it's a good sound that tells you to relax, cruise, or hang out with friends. https://open.spotify.com/track/3ltwE4GYip8FKL0zEw10w5?si=f2810ba8a6a840e5 Lil_trip2much's emotional, melodic singing fits the beat, making the song feel like it's telling a story at night and making you think about yourself. Joe brrrr gives this a sharper, more confident bounce, which keeps the song interesting from start to finish. It feels like two friends sharing the music they listen to when they go out. Lil_trip2much and Joe brrrr's song "Double Cup" shows that melodic rap can still have intimacy, atmosphere, and an undeniable groove.  "Double Cup" excels in production because it is so unpretentious. The smooth, atmospheric instruments fit perfectly with the melodic flows. They never cover up the singing, but they do make the song feel more real. You can listen to this song while driving through the city, at a small party, or when you need to think about something important. It won't lose its strength. This song is a mood for those times when everything is perfect, the world is quiet, and the lights are low. Follow Lil_trip2much on Instagram
